{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the infant family practice master’s program at the T. Denny Sanford School of Social and Family Dynamics. Please review the program handbook for information on program procedures, policy, courses offered, timelines and more.
Applications for this program are due by March 15, however, this program has a rolling admissions policy. Students are admitted as applications are received. Space is limited, so prospective students are encouraged to apply early. Find out more about the admissions procedures.
Submit your application today
Please email me any questions about the application or program.
Thank you and we look forward to hearing from you!
Gina Perez Graduate Programs Coordinator T. Denny Sanford School of Social and Family Dynamics 480-965-6874
